newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RDC buys Singapore land for S$26.45 mln.
newsitem.headline: RDC buys Singapore land for S$26.45 mln.

text.p: Resources Development Corporation Ltd (RDC) said on Friday a subsidiary, RDC Land Pte Ltd, had bought two land sites in Singapore for residential development at a total consideration of Singapore $26.46 million.
A deposit of S$2.6 million had been paid for the total 2,275.1 square metres, a company statement said.
The acquisition was not expected to have any impact on the company's net tangible assets or earnings for the financial year ended December 31, 1997, it added.
